pages.text: Growthcraft Apiary works best alongside vanilla bee keeping. Use vanilla bees, nests, and hives for bee production, or pair Growthcraft with the Productivity Bees mod for a deeper bee system.
Place flowers near vanilla nests and hives to keep bees productive.
Growthcraft honey combs can be pressed into honey or used in mead production. Vanilla honeycomb can also be used in Growthcraft mead recipes.
Growthcraft no longer maintains its own bee box workflow in 1.21.1. For active bee keeping, use vanilla mechanics or Productivity Bees.
